assertions.assertion: The claim is for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring
CPT code 93229 is used for the service
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The clinical indication note justifies the medical necessity of the service
The member reported symptoms of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms correlate with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The ordered evaluation's intent is fulfilled
